en.title: Habits, facts and timetables
en.summary: The simple present is used for habits, general facts and fixed timetables.

paragraphs: The simple present is used for habits, general facts and fixed timetables. It is also used for states that last for a long time. The action does not need to be happening now. It is true as a rule, or it repeats.

Adverbs of frequency, such as always, usually, often, sometimes and never, go with habits. They stand before the main verb but after be: She often walks to work, She is often late. The simple present is also used for scheduled events in the near future, such as trains and lessons.

blocks.html:
UseExample
habitShe often walks to work.
factCats eat meat.
timetableThe film starts at eight.
stateHe owns a shop.
instructionsYou turn left here.

paragraphs: From most to least often: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never. Never already makes the verb negative, so we say She never eats meat, not She doesn't never eat meat.
Expressions such as every day, once a week, on Sundays and in the morning go at the end of the sentence, or at the start for emphasis. Every day I walk to school is correct and clear.

items: Wrong: **She walks often to work.** Right: **She often walks to work.**
Wrong: **I am getting up at seven every day.** Right: **I get up at seven every day.**
Wrong: **He doesn't never come.** Right: **He never comes.**

ro.title: Obiceiuri, fapte și programe
ro.summary: În limba română, folosim timpul prezent pentru obiceiuri zilnice, adevăruri generale și programe fixe.

paragraphs: Timpul prezent arată acțiuni care se întâmplă acum. Folosim prezentul și pentru lucruri pe care le facem des. De asemenea, el exprimă fapte sigure sau evenimente dintr-un program fix.

items: Eu mă **trezesc** la ora șapte în fiecare zi.
Apa **fierbe** la o sută de grade.

paragraphs: Pentru obiceiuri, folosim cuvinte precum mereu, des, uneori sau niciodată. Forma verbului rămâne la prezent. Pentru evenimente dintr-un program fix, folosim verbul la prezent și menționăm ora.

blocks.html:
UtilizareExemplu
ObiceiEa **bea** cafea în fiecare dimineață.
Fapt generalPământul **se rotește** în jurul Soarelui.
Program fixAutobuzul **sosește** la ora trei.
FrecvențăNoi **mergem** des la teatru.
